blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of P213.75 million in alleged “commissions” was reportedly delivered to a Manila hotel for Sen. Jinggoy Estrada, former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) district engineer Henry Alcantara testified before the Sandiganbayan Second Division on Friday.
